description:
Update every chatbot setting

Saves what the chatbot editor in the dashboard saves: texts, branding, widget look, FAQ, quick replies, links, support hub, voice, model, privacy, integrations and status. Send only the fields to change. Knowledge sources are managed under `/chatbots/{chatbotId}/knowledge`. Only chatbots of your own account.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

allowedDomains.description: Hostnames allowed to embed the widget. Empty means everywhere.

chatbotDisplayName.description: Name visitors see in the chat header.

customBranding.description: Copyright text in the widget footer.

customCss.description: Extra CSS for the widget. Cleaned the same way as in the dashboard.

customLinks.description: Social and contact links shown in the widget. A link must start with http, https, mailto or tel (or be relative), anything else such as javascript: or data: is refused with 400.

floatingButtonLogo.description: Image of the floating chat button as base64 image data.

integrationIds.description: Integrations the chatbot may use, from `GET /integrations`.

integrationTools.description: Per integration id, the tools the chatbot may call.

retentionDays.description: Days conversations are kept, -1 for no limit.

supportHubConfig.description: Support hub of the widget, as the dashboard editor stores it. Texts left empty, or left at the built-in English samples, appear in the language of the visitor. Links in home.items (url) and feed.items (url, ctaUrl) must start with http, https, mailto or tel (or be relative or an anchor #), anything else such as javascript: or data: is refused with 400.

name: update_chatbot_settings
title: Update every chatbot setting
